location.address: 1/74, SH 49, East Coast Road (ECR), Muthukadu, Chennai, Tamil Nadu - 600112
location.nearby_landmarks: MGM Beach Resort, Muthukadu Boat House, Kovalam Beach

park_timings.notes: Open on all 365 days including government and national holidays

thunder_rock_falls.session_2: 04:00 PM - 04:30 PM (04:00 PM - 04:20 PM on weekends)

packages.name: Jumbo Package
packages.inclusions: Full day unlimited access to all general Dry Rides and all Water World attractions.

packages.name: Mega Fun Package
packages.inclusions: Full day unlimited access to Dry & Water Rides + 5D Theatre + Upside Down House + D'Evil House + Vortex + 4 Carnival Game coupons.

packages.name: Priority Pass
packages.inclusions: Expedited single-entry express queue bypass for rides + Mega Fun Package privileges + Combo Food Menu + Costume Combo.

height_criteria.child: Height between 2 ft 6 in and 4 ft 4 in (76 cm to 132 cm)
height_criteria.infant: Height under 2 ft 6 in enter FREE

promotions_and_discounts.name: Buy 2 Get 2 Free
promotions_and_discounts.description: Book 2 regular tickets and receive 2 complimentary tickets. Valid on select weekday promotional periods.

promotions_and_discounts.name: Buy 4 Get 2 Free
promotions_and_discounts.description: Special group saver package. Buy 4 regular tickets, get 2 free.

promotions_and_discounts.name: College / School Student Discount
promotions_and_discounts.description: 25% instant discount upon presenting a valid original student ID card.

promotions_and_discounts.name: Group Booking Offer
promotions_and_discounts.description: 20% discount for organized groups of 25 or more persons.

promotions_and_discounts.name: Day Out @ MGM
promotions_and_discounts.description: Combined package granting access to both MGM Beach Resort private beach facilities and MGM Dizzee World.

ticket_pricing.cancellation_policy: Cancellation permitted up to 48 hours before date of visit subject to 25% cancellation penalty. Non-refundable within 48 hours.

dress_code_policy.general: Shirts, bottoms (trousers, jeans, bermudas, three-fourths), and footwear mandatory at all times on park grounds. Offensive graphics or see-through clothes forbidden.
dress_code_policy.water_rides: Costumes strictly mandatory. Only Synthetic, Lycra, Polyester, Spandex, or Nylon allowed. Denim and metal buttons/zippers banned. Costumes available for purchase inside.

amenities_and_facilities.ev_charging: 1 EV charging station located at MGM Beach Resort adjacent to the parking area.
amenities_and_facilities.lockers_and_baggage: Baggage counter available on a first-come, first-served basis.
amenities_and_facilities.food_policy: Outside food IS permitted in MGM Dizzee World (unique policy among amusement parks).
amenities_and_facilities.first_aid: On-site medical center with first aid staff.
amenities_and_facilities.wifi: No public Wi-Fi inside the park. High-speed cell coverage from Jio, Airtel, and Vi.
amenities_and_facilities.photography: Personal cameras and DSLRs permitted. GoPros and selfie sticks are strictly prohibited for safety.

dining_venues.name: Surfin Food Court (Pure Vegetarian)
dining_venues.cuisines: South Indian (Idli, Dosa, Vada, Uthappam), North Indian (Roti, Naan, Paneer gravies), Chinese (Fried Rice, Noodles), American (Pizzas, Burgers, Sandwiches)

dining_venues.name: Dizzeeden Food Court (Non-Vegetarian)
dining_venues.cuisines: Chicken Biryani, Kebabs, North Indian Chicken curries, Parottas, Fast food and Chilled Beverages
